title: I Got Married to the Girl I Hate Most in Class
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Saito Hojo, heir to a large corporation, and his classroom rival Akane Sakuramori are told by their grandparents, who once loved each other but never married, to marry and live together; Saito's inheritance depends on it. The bickering pair keep the marriage secret at school while sharing a house, and slowly fall in love. Rivals include Akane's childhood friend Himari, Saito's cousin Shisei and Akane's manipulative younger sister Maho; manga adaptation of a light novel.
life_message: Living side by side and learning each other's real goals can turn rivalry into love and commitment.
